attestation_shares_expiry_check.name: attestation_shares_expiry_check
attestation_shares_expiry_check.value: expires_at > created_at and expires_at <= created_at + interval '90 days'

mandates_uses_check.name: mandates_uses_check
mandates_uses_check.value: max_uses is null or uses <= max_uses

org_settings_retention_check.name: org_settings_retention_check
org_settings_retention_check.value: request_log_days between 7 and 3650 and media_days between 1 and 3650

posture_waivers_expiry_check.name: posture_waivers_expiry_check
posture_waivers_expiry_check.value: expires_at > created_at and expires_at <= created_at + interval '180 days'

principals_risk_tier_check.name: principals_risk_tier_check
principals_risk_tier_check.value: risk_tier is null or risk_tier in ('low', 'medium', 'high')
